exposure: Absence of medical problems of mothers
cohort: The participants were 344 low-birth-weight preterm neonates admitted to neonatal intensive care unit of public hospitals in Bahir Dar City.
finding: The median time to adequate weight gain was 15 days, with absence of medical problems of mothers, spontaneous vaginal mode of delivery, and long duration of labor identified as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal mode of delivery was a significant predictor for a shorter time to adequate weight gain (AHR: 1.53, 95% CI 1.028, 2.593).
